definitions.gloss: popular song; hit song of an era
definitions.explanation: A song that is widely popular at a particular time, especially the popular songs of earlier decades. Somewhat dated; the word evokes the popular music of the past rather than current pop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流行歌|りゅうこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{口|くち}ずさんだ→口ずさむ：18513_kuchizusamu⟧。
examples.english: I hummed an old popular song.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流行歌|りゅうこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧。
examples.english: My mother often sings the popular songs of her youth.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流行歌|りゅうこうか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{愛|あい}された→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧。
examples.english: That song was loved by many as a popular song of the postwar period.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{流行|りゅうこう}→流行：03678_ryuukou⟧ (being in vogue) + {歌|か／うた} (song). Also read はやりうた, with the same meaning and a slightly more colloquial feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{流行歌|りゅうこうか}: an old popular song
- {流行歌|りゅうこうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧: to sing a popular song

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{歌謡曲|かようきょく}→歌謡曲：20396_kayoukyoku⟧: popular song — a genre label for mainstream Japanese pop of the mid-20th century
- ⟦ヒット{曲|きょく}→ヒット曲：25764_hittokyoku⟧: hit song — modern, neutral term for any currently or recently popular song
